messages:
lina: Quick sync — I'm finishing the whats-new entry and changelog bullets for the SDK API rename and the anchor reorganization. Need owners for snippet updates and a short known-issues block.
omar: I'll take JS and browser samples. Which files are impacted?
lina: docs/sdk/js/quickstart.md, docs/examples/browser.md, and a few anchor targets under whats-new that moved when we consolidated headings. docs-bot flagged some.
docs-bot: linkcheck: 5 failed anchors detected; 2 external 404s. Full log attached to PR 7309.
tony: I'll handle Python and CLI examples. Note: resp.text -> resp.output.text and max_len -> max_tokens. I suggest adding a compact compatibility snippet in the migration guide instead of duplicating examples.
omar: Sounds good. For JS I'll update `new RedwoodClient()` -> `new Redwood()` and add a one-line migration note pointing to the migration guide. PR 7312 opened.
qa-nina: Tag me when PRs are ready with staging links. I'll run smoke tests on staging Dedicated: short generate, streaming long generate. Watch APAC streaming fallback — we saw partial chunks last week.
eng-runtime: FYI streaming fallback behavior was adjusted; include an explicit note in whats-new: "Streaming fallback may produce partial chunks in some APAC zones; we're tracking a mitigation" and link INF-1133.
lina: Draft changelog bullets so far: - SDK: client class rename and select param updates (see migration guide) - Docs: anchor reorg and redirect fixes - Known issue: embeddings streaming partials in APAC - Note: legacy alias kept for one release as a compatibility shim
tony: Added Python compatibility snippet in PR 7316 showing new + shim usage and a quick test snippet.
omar: I pushed the JS updates and a temporary anchor redirect stub to reduce Netlify TTL fallout in PR 7312.
docs-bot: deploy: whats-new staging build queued. Netlify redirect TTL ~20-40m may cause transient anchor mismatches.
qa-nina: Scheduling verification window Thursday 09:00 PT. Please include a tiny test plan in each PR (two requests: short and long with streaming).
lina: Plan: merge snippets + anchor fixes, QA signoff, then publish whats-new and final changelog. ETA: EOD Thursday. Will ping docs-approvers once changelog draft is up. Thanks all!
